mail_1.subject: Recruitment
mail_1.main_text:
Congratulations!

Your placement within the editorial division of The Republica Post has been formally confirmed. Your profile has been monitored for some time, and your progression in the field has not gone unnoticed. We have identified key attributes in your work that mark you as suitable for entry-level editorial operations.

As of this transmission, you are granted Level 1 clearance. This includes provisional access to curated internal sources, press releases approved by the Information Ministry, and a limited archive segment. You are to review, verify, and format daily reports into publishable articles for end-of-day submission. Timeliness is non-negotiable. Source contact outside approved channels is grounds for immediate disciplinary review.

Your terminal briefing will be waiting upon login. You are expected to begin immediately. Remember: your work shapes the truth. The public relies on us to deliver clarity and we rely on you to uphold our standard.

You are now part of something larger.
Do not disappoint.

— Office of Editorial Compliance
